# metaDyn

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan 2026-03-19

## Description

Fits fixed-, random-, or mixed-effects multivariate meta-analysis models
using dynamic model estimates from each individual.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `metaDyn` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn) with:

``` r

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("jeksterslab/metaDyn")
```

## Documentation

See [GitHub Pages](https://jeksterslab.github.io/metaDyn/index.html) for
package documentation.

## References

Cheung, M. W.-L. (2015). *Meta-analysis: A structural equation modeling
approach*. Wiley. <https://doi.org/10.1002/9781118957813>

Hunter, M. D. (2017). State space modeling in an open source, modular,
structural equation modeling environment. *Structural Equation Modeling:
A Multidisciplinary Journal*, *25*(2), 307–324.
<https://doi.org/10.1080/10705511.2017.1369354>

Neale, M. C., Hunter, M. D., Pritikin, J. N., Zahery, M., Brick, T. R.,
Kirkpatrick, R. M., Estabrook, R., Bates, T. C., Maes, H. H., & Boker,
S. M. (2015). OpenMx 2.0: Extended structural equation and statistical
modeling. *Psychometrika*, *81*(2), 535–549.
<https://doi.org/10.1007/s11336-014-9435-8>

R Core Team. (2025). *R: A language and environment for statistical
computing*. R Foundation for Statistical Computing.
<https://www.R-project.org/>

# Package index

## Functions

- [`Meta()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/Meta.md) :
  Fit Multivariate Meta-Analysis
- [`MetaVARMx()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/MetaVARMx.md)
  : Fit Multivariate Meta-Analysis (metaVAR via OpenMx)

## Methods

- [`coef(`*`<metadynmeta>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/coef.metadynmeta.md)
  :

  Estimated Parameter Method for an Object of Class `metadynmeta`

- [`confint(`*`<metadynmeta>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/confint.metadynmeta.md)
  : Confidence Intervals for the Parameter Estimates

- [`extract()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/extract.md)
  : Extract Generic Function

- [`extract(`*`<metadynmeta>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/extract.metadynmeta.md)
  :

  Extract Method for an Object of Class `metadynmeta`

- [`print(`*`<metadynmeta>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/print.metadynmeta.md)
  :

  Print Method for Object of Class `metadynmeta`

- [`summary(`*`<metadynmeta>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/summary.metadynmeta.md)
  :

  Summary Method for Object of Class `metadynmeta`

- [`vcov(`*`<metadynmeta>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/metaDyn/reference/vcov.metadynmeta.md)
  :

  Variance-Covariance Matrix Method for an Object of Class `metadynmeta`
